==Usage==
This template is for ''[[Wookieepedia:WookieeProject Aliens|WookieeProject Aliens]]'', to update in a number of different places the number of Featured articles created by the Project. When a new FA is passed or an old one is stripped of its status, update this number. It will then automatically be updated on various other ''WookieeProject Aliens'' subpages.
[[Category:WookieeProject Aliens]]
